cells.gaps: No share or count of health centres or health posts entering their own reports is published; the 100% completeness of Q1 2026 (GIN-009) is data transmitted, not facility entry. The sources disagree on where data is keyed: the 2021 yearbook and a 2022 project statement have some health-centre heads entering in DHIS2 (GIN-034, GIN-037), while the newer rows have paper tools keyed at the district (GIN-025) and rural centres reporting on paper (GIN-024); GIN-025 is dated only to its published year.
cells.note: All levels of the pyramid report into the ministry's DHIS2 and the clinics' paper reports are keyed at the district, which is stage 3's whole row. Stage 4 needs facility entry by more than half of primary clinics on a share or a count, and no figure is held.

cells.gaps: No denominator of hospitals is held, so the 19 public establishments on Visa Medical and the five OpenClinic facilities cannot be read as most T1 and T2 hospitals; the tier of all but two named sites is not stated. Clinic+O's record at community health centres carries no count and no district, and is captured by community health workers; a second owner, the partner Clinic+O (GIN-020), stands beside the vendor, and no plan naming any of the three systems is held. Whether a Visa Medical record can be retrieved at another facility is not stated.
cells.note: Three separate records run in some hospitals and pilot facilities, entered at the point of care, which is stage 2. Stage 3 needs most T1 and T2 hospitals or primary clinics in some districts, and the evidence gives neither a hospital denominator nor a count or district for the health centres.
